description: Simplify Alpha has opened an AI engineering centre in Hyderabad and plans to scale its headcount to 1,000 professionals within two years.
body_lead: Simplify Alpha has opened an AI Engineering Centre at HITEC City in Hyderabad and plans to expand its headcount to 1,000 professionals over the next two years, adding another healthcare technology operation to Telangana’s growing global innovation ecosystem. Telangana IT Minister D Sridhar Babu inaugurated the facility on Monday in the presence of Venkatgiri Vandali, co-founder and chief executive officer of Simplify Alpha, and other members of the company’s senior leadership team. Simplify Alpha is part of Simplify Group, a healthcare technology company headquartered in Chicago.
